backlog.title: Items scroll out of the 50-newest-email pull window before being actioned (Quirke/Access Group case)
backlog.recommendation: Fixed -- Phase 3.9 v2 fresh design pass: checkpoints every live Urgent/Needs card into triage_ledger.json's tracked_needs_urgent; when an item scrolls out of the 50-newest pull, checks Outlook Parent.EntryID / Command Centre done:true / dashboard tick done:true in that order, fails open on inconclusive Outlook lookups, warns-but-still-carries past 90 days. Shipped in the same changeset as a tick-key stability fix (day-independent, position-independent keys) needed to avoid reproducing the 17 Aug tick-resurrection bug. Verified live against 4 real entry_ids confirmed to have scrolled out of the pull window (3 still open in Outlook, would have been silently dropped by the unpatched pipeline; 1 correctly failed open on a transient COM error).
backlog.source: work-inbox commit a50802ce (fetch_inbox.py, Phase 3.9 v2), merged to main via 863e2922 and deployed live 20 Aug 2026; drew/memory/wi-phase1-scrollout-dragdrop-rework-20aug.md, drew/memory/wi-phase1-deploy-live-20aug.md

backlog.title: Drag-and-drop full-rebuild bug fixed -- cards no longer disappear/reshuffle on drag, especially cross-zone moves
backlog.recommendation: priDragEnd() no longer calls renderBriefing() (full six-zone innerHTML rebuild) on any drag outcome. Cancelled/no-op drags revert with one insertBefore; same-zone reorders need no patch (dragover preview already left correct order); cross-zone moves regenerate only the one moved card via _priRenderOneCard + replaceWith. Verified via a 20-check jsdom suite plus a real-browser Playwright drag against live briefing.json (88 cards before and after both a cross-zone drag and a same-zone reorder, zero lost). Note: this was verified as a work-inbox-only change -- checked command-centre's own commit history for js/app.js directly and found no equivalent drag-and-drop rework there, despite the original finding being framed as spanning both dashboards; flagging rather than asserting a command-centre fix that isn't independently confirmed.
backlog.source: work-inbox commit 3cc77c80 (js/app.js), merged to main via 863e2922, deployed live 20 Aug 2026; drew/memory/wi-phase1-scrollout-dragdrop-rework-20aug.md

backlog.title: Silent pipeline failures now surfaced via desktop toast across all 3 pipeline stages
backlog.recommendation: fetch_inbox.py already fired a real desktop toast on failure as of 20 Aug (Phase 3.6). The remaining 2 stages, tools/publish_needs_reply.py and tools/publish_drafted_replies.py, now import a new shared tools/phase_failure_notify.py and fire the same toast. Verified live via the BurntToast registry counter (+1 per real failure, +0 on --dry-run) against the real production tools/ directory. Two related gaps found and fixed in the same pass: the local Run Inbox Briefing.bat had no download step for the new module (would have crashed the next scheduled run), and a pre-existing duplicate :notify_failure subroutine in the same .bat would have double-toasted -- both fixed.
backlog.source: work-inbox commits ab1f6bb4 (fetch_inbox.py, 20 Aug) and e847033f (tools/phase_failure_notify.py, 21 Aug), both on main; drew/memory/wi-phase2-silentfail-finish-ticksretry-correction-21aug.md

backlog.title: Absences panel showed incorrect concurrent "off today, returns Monday 24 August" for multiple people -- first-write-wins dedup bug in fetch_inbox.py's _add_absence()
backlog.recommendation: Fixed: merge logic now bridges two real absence entries into one continuous window only when the gap between them is entirely non-working (weekend) days -- otherwise treats them as genuinely separate absences and surfaces whichever covers today or is soonest upcoming. Two distinct root causes: (1) separate real absences (e.g. three individual A/L days on different weeks) were being force-merged into a fabricated continuous window; (2) a placeholder-organizer name-resolution bug (Python .title() mangling 'Ant'S' from subject-parsed text) split one person (Anthony Kong) into two different dedup keys -- now resolved via MAPI PR_SENDER_NAME through PropertyAccessor instead of subject-text parsing. Already merged and live-verified on both work-inbox and command-centre dashboards (both consume this same panel data); no further action needed, though a regression test covering multi-entry-per-person dedup windows would guard against recurrence.
backlog.source: begb0037admin/work-inbox/fetch_inbox.py, merged to main at commit 2cd53528; investigated and confirmed against live Outlook COM data across multiple test passes, 21 Aug 2026; verified live on both work-inbox and command-centre dashboards post-fix via rendered-page checks

Confirmed-fact memory written so future sessions don't re-verify this. Julie/Development-Insight pair (task-1785700344174 / task-1785704715215) and GLAM 38-day-balance pair (t2608111507360 / t2608120903060) merged, not just deleted -- unique actions from each removed duplicate appended into the kept record's actions[] in chronological order. tasks.json 77 -> 75 tasks. backlog.title: Staleness-clock bug fixed -- inbound mail no longer falsely resets 'last activity', now shared consistently between work-inbox and command-centre
backlog.recommendation: command-centre's lastActivityTs() counted every dated action-log entry as activity, including routine inbound-email auto-appends -- a task could receive passive mail forever and never go stale. Fixed: an (email: ...) tagged entry only counts if it's Kevin's own sent reply. A real edge case found live-verifying against data/tasks.json (not assumed): a task whose entire history is routine inbound mail with no dateAdded returned zero genuine signal and silently dropped out of staleness tracking altogether -- fixed with an earliest-dated-entry fallback (0 previously-flagged tasks lost their flag, 13 gained one; live count moved from 7 to 20 flagged of 63 non-done tasks). The identical genuine-activity rule was then applied fresh to work-inbox's own 'Priorities This Week' zone (first-ever aging/staleness visibility there), proven to agree via live cross-check (same 6 task ids, same day counts, 1-day drift from mirror-snapshot timing).
backlog.source: command-centre commit 1a79b259 (js/app.js) and work-inbox commit ece26034 (js/app.js), both on main; drew/memory/wi-phase2-item3-staleness-closeout-21aug.md
